subject: [Insightloom] follow-up to benchmark download — request for demo
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@insightloom.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-03T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Quick demo request after benchmark download

Hi Lukas,

I downloaded the benchmark you published on serving economics (great write-up — thanks). Our engineering and ML infra team at Insightloom is evaluating inference platforms to reduce per-token costs and get more predictable latency for customer-facing features.

Could we schedule a short demo to walk through the runtime optimizations and dedicated deployment options? 30 minutes would be great. We're primarily interested in:
- latency guarantees for 99th percentile
- autoscaling/reserved capacity behavior
- cold-start and KV-cache behavior for multi-tenant workloads

I've attached the benchmark that our team pulled so you have the context (insightloom-benchmark.pdf).

Preferred windows: next week mornings ET.

Best,
Samir Patel
Head of ML Infrastructure
Insightloom

Attachments: insightloom-benchmark.pdf (PDF)

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@insightloom.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-03T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request after benchmark download

Samir — thanks for downloading and for the context. Glad the benchmark was useful.

I'd be happy to set up a 30-minute walkthrough focused on the items you listed. Quick question: you wrote "mornings ET" — are you available Wednesday 10/11 at 10:00 AM ET or Thursday 10/12 at 9:30 AM ET? If those don't work, send a couple more options and we'll match.

Marissa (cc) is our AE for platform partnerships and can join the call to go over commercial/commit options if helpful.

Proposed agenda (30 min):
- 5m intros and top priorities
- 10m runtime + latency profile and autoscale behavior
- 10m deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) + cost levers
- 5m next steps / follow-ups

I'll also include a short demo brief.

Thanks,
Lukas
SDR, Redwood Inference

Related links: https://calendly.com/lukas-redwood/30min?month=2028-10

From: Samir Patel <samir@insightloom.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-03T12:01:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request after benchmark download

Hey Lukas — thanks for the quick follow-up. Sorry for not clarifying: I'm on Eastern Time (ET). The Wednesday 10/11 10:00 AM ET slot works for me, but my lead infra engineer might need to join from a slightly later slot (10:30 ET). Would it be possible to book 45 minutes at 10:00 ET so we have buffer? If not, 10:30 ET works too.

Also, can Marissa share any pre-read so our architect can skim before the call?

Cheers,
Samir

On Wed, Oct 3, 2028 at 09:14 AM Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Samir — thanks for downloading and for the context. Glad the benchmark was useful.
>

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@insightloom.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-03T15:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request after benchmark download

Samir — Marissa here, thanks for the interest and for sharing the benchmark. We can certainly extend to 45 minutes to make sure your engineer gets time for technical questions. Lukas, can you please schedule 45 minutes for 10:00 AM ET on 10/11 and include a short pre-read?

Samir, attaching a two-page demo brief that highlights the latency and autoscaling sections we plan to demo (redwood-demo-brief.pdf). If there's anything else your team wants us to prepare (e.g., a short runbook or security/compliance notes), flag it and we'll add to the agenda.

Looking forward to the conversation — sending a calendar invite shortly.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-demo-brief.pdf (PDF)

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@insightloom.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-04T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request after benchmark download — calendar confirmation

Samir — invite is booked for 10/11/2028 at 10:00 AM ET for 45 minutes. Calendar invite includes Marissa and Ava from our side.

Calendly / invite stub: https://calendly.com/lukas-redwood/30min?month=2028-10 (we used a custom slot for 45m)
Meeting agenda (sent in invite):
- 5m intros
- 15m runtime/99th percentile latency + KV cache behavior (demo)
- 15m deployment & autoscale patterns (dedicated vs hosted)
- 10m Q&A + next steps (pricing/POC plan)

Prep: please skim the attached demo brief (redwood-demo-brief.pdf); we've also attached the benchmark you sent to the event for reference.

If you need to move the time, reply with a new window and we'll pivot — also happy to add your infra engineer to the invite.

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
SDR, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-demo-brief.pdf (PDF), insightloom-benchmark.pdf (PDF)
